items.source: The default implementation is empty. Called by WebApplicationObjectSupport.initApplicationContext(org.springframework.context.ApplicationContext) as well as WebApplicationObjectSupport.setServletContext(jakarta.servlet.ServletContext).
items.translation: 默认实现为空。由WebApplicationObjectSupport.initApplicationContext(org.springframework.context.ApplicationContext)以及WebApplicationObjectSupport.setServletContext(jakarta.servlet.ServletContext)调用。

items.source: NOTE: This callback won't be triggered for singleton beans lazily initialized on demand after BeanFactory bootstrap, and not for any other bean scope either. Carefully use it for beans with the intended bootstrap semantics only.
items.translation: 注意：此回调不会为在 BeanFactory 引导后按需懒式初始化的单例 Bean 触发，也不会为任何其他 Bean 作用域触发。请仅针对具有预期引导语义的 Bean 谨慎使用它。

items.source: When this class is used, by declaring it in Spring configuration, it should be possible to turn off a Servlet container's scan for WebSocket endpoints. This can be done with the help of the <absolute-ordering> element in web.xml.
items.translation: 当通过 Spring 配置声明此类时，应能够关闭 Servlet 容器对 WebSocket 端点的扫描。这可以通过在 `web.xml` 中使用 `<absolute-ordering>` 元素来实现。

items.source:
Explicitly list annotated endpoint types that should be registered on startup. This
can be done if you wish to turn off a Servlet container's scan for endpoints, which
goes through all 3rd party jars in the classpath, and rely on Spring configuration instead.
items.translation: 显式列出应在启动时注册的注解端点类型。如果您希望关闭 Servlet 容器对端点的扫描（该扫描会遍历类路径中的所有第三方 jar），并转而依赖 Spring 配置，则可以执行此操作。
